name: pragmatic-delivery
description: Risk-adaptive 80/20 software delivery for Codex and Claude Code

interface.shortDescription: Ship small correct changes; plan or review only when risk justifies it.
interface.longDescription: Installs an 80/20 delivery policy for ordinary software changes, a bounded planning skill for material uncertainty, and a focused security review for high-impact boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Install pragmatic delivery rules in this project.
Plan this complex change without producing a full spec.
Review the security-critical boundaries of this change.
